worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.summary: The user crams a mass of filthy garbage into its body and fires it straight as a cannon shell: the only physical hit in the family, dealing heavy damage, shoving the target hard and possibly poisoning it. The shell carries a spread, so it misses more the farther it flies. Heavy load hits harder and drifts more; light load is steadier and faster.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.use.0: One very heavy physical hit at range
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.use.2: Gamble on a shot that can miss
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.description.0: A direct hit deals about %1$s physical damage. The shell has up to ±%2$s degrees of random spread, so it slips past a target more often the farther it flies; the target's Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.description.1: On a hit the target is shoved %1$s blocks along the shell and has a %2$s poison chance; the poison lasts %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.description.2: The shell flies straight at %1$s blocks/tick and reaches up to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.heavy.on: Heavy load on: ×1.18 damage and ×1.25 shove, but ×1.4 spread, +2 ticks of load time and +4 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.heavy.off: Heavy load off (Light load): tighter spread, a faster shot and a shorter cooldown, but every shell is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.growth.0: At level %1$s the shell rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of shove.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.growth.1: At level %1$s the shell rises to %2$s power and the poison chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.preference.he: On: ×1.18 damage and ×1.25 shove, but ×1.4 spread (harder to land), +2 ticks of load time and +4 ticks of cooldown, for gambling on a big hit or blasting a large target back. Off (Light load): tighter spread, a faster shot and a shorter cooldown, but every shell is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.gunkshot.preference.ai: Only foes within this distance become firing candidates; the shared approach logic then walks the companion into range. Higher starts the chase earlier.
On, larger targets (harder to slip past, shoved farther) are ranked higher; off ranks by distance alone.
On, the companion may leave its post to fire; off restricts it to shots it can make from where it stands.
